examples.title: Create a reusable temporary expression
examples.code:
# Define a temporary expression for use by deep channel expressions.
expr = nuke.createNode("DeepExpression")
expr.setInput(0, deep_image)
expr["temp_name0"].setValue("depthMask")
expr["temp_expr0"].setValue("clamp(1-z/100)")

provenance.editorial_note: Foundry documents temp_name0/temp_expr0 as reusable expression fields; the expression itself is editorial.
